12. 10. 10-15

Chedanādisuttāni

3942-3947. Evameva kho bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye chedana - vadha - bandhana - viparāmosa - ālopa - sahasākārā paṭiviratā. atha kho eteva bahutarā sattāye chedana - vadha - bandhana - viparāmosa - ālopa - sahasākārā appaṭiviratā. Taṃ kissa hetu, adiṭṭhattā bhikkhave, catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ. Katamesaṃ catunnaṃ: dukkhassa ariyasaccassa, dukkhasamudayassa ariyasaccassa, dukkhanirodhassa ariyasaccassa, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ariyasaccassa. Tasmātiha bhikkhave, "idaṃ dukkha"nti yogo karaṇīyo. "Ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo"ti yogo karaṇīyoti. "Ayaṃ dukkhanirodho"ti yogo karaṇīyoti. "Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā"ti yogo karaṇīyoti. 

Catuttha āmakadhaññapeyyālavaggo dasamo. 

Tatruddānaṃ:

Khettaṃ kayaṃ dūteyyañca tulātūṭaṃ kaṃsakūṭaṃ, 

Mānakūṭaṃ ukkoṭanaṃ vañcananikati, chedanā, 

Vadhabandhanaṃ viparāmosālopasāhasānīti. 

11. Pañcagatipeyyālavaggo
